## Quality Gate
- [ ] Problem & acceptance criteria described
- [ ] Branch name follows convention (feature/, fix/, chore/)
- [ ] Project builds locally and in CI (if applicable)
- [ ] Unit & integration tests added/updated; tests pass
- [ ] Critical Journey(s) documented and passing (if applicable)
- [ ] Security implications considered
- [ ] Documentation updated (README/docs)
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry (if applicable)

## Notes for reviewers
- List focused areas for review and any known limitations or unknowns.
